newsitem.title: USA: Purus president, board member resign.
newsitem.headline: Purus president, board member resign.

text.p: Purus Inc said Russell Burbank resigned as chairman, president and chief executive officer. Another board member, Michael Dettmers, also resigned.
Both resignations became effective on November 19.
The company said that the remaining director, Reinhard Siegrist, named Joel Mesznik and Hans Ochsner to fill the vacancies.
The company was not immediately available to say who would fill the position of chairman, president and chief executive.

In addition, the company said it plans to adjourn its annual meeting, currently set for December 5, so that the new board can "reexamine the merits of the ... proposed $3.00 per share cash distribution."
